verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents screening customers against sanctions, PEP and adverse-media databases through one API (synchronous or asynchronous). Hits are reviewed in a single case-management surface, in the web app or via the API. But nothing in the evidence shows it performs the identity verification itself, so the 'same verification, one vendor' part of the story is not established. Missing for 10: first-party identity verification in the same flow as screening, independent or hands-on corroboration of screening results.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can screen verified users against sanctions, PEP, and adverse-media watchlists as part of the same verification — one vendor, one API, one review surface

citations.quote: you can check your customers against a global database of Sanctions, Warning, Fitness and Probity and Watchlists, Politically Exposed Persons registers (PEPs) and Adverse Media.
Synchronous screening: Ideal for real-time onboarding workflows where low latency is critical.
Cases, alerts and risks can be reviewed and remediated either via the ComplyAdvantage Mesh web application or by integrating with the API for use in your own case management system.
Its case management solution allows you to prioritise and review risk alerts raised during onboarding and ongoing monitoring.
